title: P-384 sig_len_max 105 vs 104 inconsistency
description: PIV hardware slot tables hardcode 105u for P-384 ECDSA max signature length. ks_key_sig_len_max() formula 8+2*key_size returns 104 for P-384. Soft keygen also uses 104. Both are correct upper bounds (tight=104, slack=105). Without a comment, contributors see conflicting numbers and cannot tell which is authoritative. Added comments at ks_key_sig_len_max() explaining the formula and at the hardware slot table explaining the intentional +1 slack.
